verdict.rationale: xAI docs explicitly discuss latency metrics like time-to-first-token (TTFT) and inter-token latency (ITL) via the Priority Processing feature, and the OpenAI-compatible REST API strongly implies standard token streaming support, but the evidence pack never directly documents a streaming parameter/endpoint or provides concrete latency benchmarks/SLAs for developers to rely on. missing for 10: explicit streaming API documentation (e.g., stream=true SSE example), published latency numbers or benchmarks, independent verification of streaming behavior.
